messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging oncall: High tail latency and elevated 5xxs for tenant 'MediNova' on Dedicated pool us-west-2a. Affected routes: /v1/chat (gen), /v1/embeddings. Current p99 > 2.5s, error rate up ~3x. Please investigate.
sarah_k: I'm on it. grabbing dashboard.
leo_w: oncall handover: sarah has the pager, i'm available if you need cluster-level changes.
sarah_k: metrics quick snapshot: queue depth per-host jumping from ~10 -> 120 for medinova-tenant, batch sizes averaging 18, max_batch_tokens=4096, scheduler window looks normal. GPUs at ~60% but serving threads backed up.
james_m: Do we have a per-tenant shaper enabled? Could be head-of-line from large batching trying to fill.
irene_ops: medinova is on bespoke config: dedicated pool w/ bespoke scheduling knobs. They requested higher throughput last quarter.
sarah_k: hypothesis: tenant is accumulating requests waiting to fill large batches => long queuing before dispatch -> tail latency. Plan: temporarily reduce max_batch_tokens for that tenant and enable strict per-tenant concurrency cap + drain excess queue.
leo_w: agree. Suggest change: max_batch_tokens -> 768, max_inflight_requests -> 40 for medinova. We'll monitor p99 + queue depth. Canary on 1 host first.
sarah_k: preparing CLI patch.

sarah_k: ```
# canary patch on host h-w2-03
rictl tenant update --tenant medinova \
  --pool us-west-2a \
  --set scheduler.knobs.max_batch_tokens=768 \
  --set scheduler.knobs.max_inflight_requests=40 \
  --target-host h-w2-03
``` 

deploy-bot: Scheduled patch job queued for h-w2-03. Job id: jb-9942. Rolling update will respect in-flight requests.

james_m: while that rolls, can we also throttle burst routing to dedicated pool? route fallback to hosted for non-SLA routes.
leo_w: yes: add routing weight 0.7 -> hosted for medinova non-critical endpoints.
sarah_k: applying quick routing tweak (no downtime):

sarah_k: ```
rictl routing update --tenant medinova --route /v1/embeddings --fallback-hosted-weight 0.7
``` 

deploy-bot: routing update accepted.

sarah_k: canary patch applied on h-w2-03. Observing now.

leo_w: initial metrics after 45s: host queue depth dropped 120 -> 18, batch size mean 18 -> 6, p99 for that host down 2.6s -> 0.9s. GPU utilization minimal change. Good signal.
irene_ops: customer success pinged medinova: FYI we're performing mitigation; may see small throughput change for some non-critical endpoints.
james_m: keep watch for 429s or client errors from reduced inflight. any unexpected 5xx spikes elsewhere?
sarah_k: no new 5xxs, overall error rate trending down. I'm going to roll change to rest of pool in 2-phase: first 25% hosts, then remaining if stable.
leo_w: ack. Also schedule a short-lived queue-drain job to avoid in-flight backlog causing duplicate work: set grace window 30s.
sarah_k: rolling to 25%... job jb-9942-step2 started.

sarah_k: After 5m: p99 cluster-wide down 2.5s -> 1.0s, error rate back to baseline. Queue depth per-host stabilized ~12. No customer-visible incidents reported.
james_m: recommend leaving knobs at these conservative values for 2 hours, then evaluate with workload replay/evals for throughput impact.
irene_ops: I'll keep CS updated and draft a short post-incident summary for Medinova support ticket.
leo_w: also add a scheduled task to run model-level batching eval overnight to see if we can regain some throughput with smarter batching heuristics.
sarah_k: creating followup ticket: INT-4573 (investigate long-term knob values + adaptive tenant shaper). Assigning to eng-runtime.

sarah_k: rolling full change complete across pool. Monitoring for 30m.

deploy-bot: All patch jobs completed: jb-9942 status: success.

sarah_k: 30m check: p99 stable ~1.0s, no new alerts. Closing pager. Thx team.
leo_w: great work. please include exact knobs + timeline in the incident note.
james_m: one follow-up: run synthetic load with peak tail patterns to tune max_batch_tokens auto-scaler.
irene_ops: CS update posted to ticket. Medinova notified and thanked for the heads-up.

sarah_k: final notes: mitigation steps — reduced scheduler.knobs.max_batch_tokens to 768, scheduler.knobs.max_inflight_requests to 40, routing fallback weight to hosted 0.7 for /v1/embeddings, canary -> 25% -> 100% rollout. Created INT-4573 for long-term work. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
